discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission of one pinned six-harness resource-overhead batch. The benchmark uses a local scripted mock rather than a real model, three serial runs per harness, and reports the median run. W1 preserves process-resource measurements and publisher beta CU values without treating them as task-quality outcomes or universal efficiency scores.
